title: Open a sub-account for a member

summary.does: Signs on to CoreOne as the operator, finds the member by member number and opens a new sub-account (Holiday Club or Vacation Savings) with an initial deposit and a nickname. IRREVERSIBLE: the final Confirm commits the account and requires approval.
summary.needs: memberId (5-digit member number), product (Holiday Club | Vacation Savings), initialDeposit (decimal, 2 places) and nickname. The operator credential is resolved at run time (mockbank-operator).
summary.returns: On success: confirmationNumber (SA-nnnnnn). Business outcomes: member_not_found, validation_rejected, permission_denied.

params.name: memberId
params.description: The 5-digit member number to look up.

params.name: initialDeposit
params.description: The opening deposit amount, as an exact decimal with up to 2 places.

params.name: nickname
params.description: A nickname for the new sub-account, shown to the member.

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: CoreOne's confirmation number for the opened sub-account.

steps.description: Open CoreOne; the frameset loads the Sign On page into the content frame.
Type the operator user id from the credential store into User ID.

target.description: User ID input on the Sign On page

ladder.rationale: Primary rung: the label sits in the adjacent <td> (no <label for>, no id, no ARIA), so the input has no accessible name and role/label rungs cannot resolve it. The label text is stable; breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: User ID is the first input of the Sign On form. Breaks if a field is added before it.

steps.description: Type the operator password from the credential store into Password. The secret is resolved at run time and never stored.

target.description: Password input on the Sign On page

ladder.rationale: Primary rung: the label sits in the adjacent <td>, so the password input has no accessible name. The label text is stable; breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: Password is the second input of the Sign On form. Breaks if a field is added before it.

steps.description: Submit the Sign On form; the content frame shows Member Search.

ladder.name: Sign On
ladder.rationale: An <input type=submit> exposes role button with its value as the accessible name. Breaks only if the caption changes.
The submit input's value is its visible caption. Survives a lost accessibility role.

steps.description: Type the requested member number into Member #.

target.description: Member # input on the Member Search page

ladder.rationale: Primary rung: the label sits in the adjacent <td>, so the input (name txt1) has no accessible name. The label text is stable; breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: Member # is the first input of the search form. Breaks if a field is added before it.

steps.description: Run the search; the content frame shows Member Inquiry for the member.

target.description: Search button on the Member Search page

ladder.name: Search
ladder.rationale: An <input type=submit value=Search> exposes role button named Search. Breaks only if the caption changes.
The submit input's value is its visible caption; exact match avoids the "Member Search" heading.
Last resort: Search is the only button of the Member Search form, so it resolves even when the caption is relabelled (tenant B reads "Find"). Breaks if a button is added before it.

steps.description: Follow the Open Sub-Account link on Member Inquiry; the content frame shows the Open Sub-Account form.

target.description: Open Sub-Account link on the Member Inquiry page

ladder.name: Open Sub-Account
ladder.rationale: A plain <a> exposes role link with its text as the name. Breaks only if the link is relabelled.
The visible link text. Survives a lost accessibility role.

steps.description: Choose the requested sub-account product. The page does not change; the checkpoint confirms the form is still shown.

target.description: Product dropdown on the Open Sub-Account form

ladder.rationale: Primary rung: the label sits in the adjacent <td> (no <label for>, no id), so the select has no accessible name. The label text is stable; breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: position 0 among the selects of the form. Breaks if a field is added before it.

target.description: Initial Deposit input on the Open Sub-Account form

ladder.rationale: Primary rung: the label sits in the adjacent <td> (no <label for>, no id), so the input has no accessible name. The label text is stable; breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: position 0 among the inputs of the form. Breaks if a field is added before it.

target.description: Nickname input on the Open Sub-Account form

ladder.rationale: Primary rung: the label sits in the adjacent <td> (no <label for>, no id), so the input has no accessible name. The label text is stable; breaks if the row is relabelled.
Last resort: position 1 among the inputs of the form. Breaks if a field is added before it.

steps.description: Continue to the review screen. Nothing is committed yet.

target.description: Continue button on the Open Sub-Account form

ladder.name: Continue
ladder.rationale: An <input type=submit value=Continue> exposes role button named Continue. Breaks only if the caption changes.
The submit input's value is its visible caption. Survives a lost accessibility role.

steps.description: Confirm and open the sub-account. IRREVERSIBLE: policy requires approval before this click. The click raises a native confirm dialog ("This action cannot be undone. Continue?"); the replay engine accepts that dialog as part of the approved action, never on its own.

target.description: Confirm button on the Review Sub-Account page

ladder.name: Confirm
ladder.rationale: An <input type=submit value=Confirm> exposes role button named Confirm. Breaks only if the caption changes.
The submit input's value is its visible caption. Survives a lost accessibility role.

steps.description: Read the confirmation number of the new sub-account.

ladder.rationale: The number is the cell right of the Confirmation # row header; the header text is stable. Breaks if the table is pivoted.
Last resort: the second cell of the row that holds Confirmation #. Breaks if a column is inserted.

outcomeRules.description: No member has this member number.

signature.text: No records match your search criteria

outcomeRules.description: CoreOne rejected the member number as invalid.
The operator is not entitled to this function (SEC-403).
The scheduled-maintenance notice alert raised when Member Inquiry loads; accepting it is harmless.
The session expired and CoreOne returned to Sign On; sign on again once and resume.
CoreOne showed its server error page.
